text:
laura: Dropping a small PR draft with 'schema-slim' examples (python + tiny SDK snippets) for tool calling and structured output. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1502 — can reviewers glance for accuracy, link targets, and migration wording?
docs-bot: preview ready at https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1502 :white_check_mark:
jess: Quick skim. Love the python example. Two small things: the snippet uses `resp.schema` in one place and `resp.output_schema` in another; unify to `resp.schema`.
laura: Good catch, will normalize. Also added a brief "guardrail" example showing a schema that rejects unknown keys.
chen: For nullable-item arrays prefer explicit anyOf on items; using `type: ['object','null']` can be ambiguous across validators. Example I'd suggest: ```json
{"type":"array","items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"object"},{"type":"null"}]}}
```
sameer: Added: runtime will coerce empty-string differently across bindings; put a migration note that some downstream parsers convert empty strings to null or drop keys. Worth calling out.
jess: Docs-link nit: there's a stale reference to /docs/callers in the guide. Canonical route is /docs/tooling/calls — update that so redirects don't break inline anchors.
laura: Pushed link fix and schema rename. One ask: should we include a one-line streaming fallback for python to mirror the js examples? e.g.: ```py
res = client.call(...)
if res.stream:
    for chunk in res.stream:
        handle(chunk)
```
chen: Yes please — add it. Many folks hit stream vs non-stream surprises.
sameer: Also propose a tiny docs-lint rule suggestion in the PR description to flag `type: [..]` on items and recommend anyOf. I can prototype a rule for the repo.
laura: Nice, added a TODO in the PR and a small migration checklist: run evals, test parsers, update links.
docs-bot: CI passed :rocket: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1502?v=2
jess: LGTM after the streaming line.
chen: :+1: no ML blockers.
sameer: I'll open a follow-up PR with the linter prototype.
laura: Thanks everyone — merging in ~15m if no objections.
